sentences.text: We present a novel, Dual-Attention Hyperbolic Feature Fusion Network (DAHFF-Net) capable of robust and efficient crop disease classification on the publicly available PlantVillage dataset with 54,306 images across 38 different disease categories from 14 crop species.

sentences.text: We also propose a curvature-adaptive margin loss function to enhance the decision boundary discrimination of visually similar diseases.
